notes.title: DevDiary 3 - "Slavic Folklore"
notes.content:
Hi there, 
Events
Inseedious is all about events. June 21 was the major slavic folk holiday: Kupala Night. 
It was believed that the sun plays and other wonders of nature happen during the shortest night of the year. Big party around fire, collecting herbs, bathing, dancing, drinking and other activities 😉

[previewyoutube=fBiSC84MNTQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Slavic Mythology
Inseedious will cover all slavic events so you can learn them on the way.
The Kupala Night is just an example of one of them. 
All events, creatures and more are based on real slavic mythology.
Inseedious will unravel it's story over time.

Follow X: https://x.com/InseediousGame
Wishlist on Steam now!

notes.title: DevDiary #2 - Two Ways
notes.content:
Hello,
As promised Inseedious's DevDiary will be a weekly short series on Thursdays to keep you on track what's going on 😉 Sooo... 
DevDiary 2 - "Two Ways"
[previewyoutube=UyHI-2C2D5k;full][/previewyoutube]

2 ways to play Inseedious:
Fighter  
Defeat all creatures, grab a loot and teleport out. 
Sounds easy but there is a roadmap of 6 levels + bossfight to secure a loot.
Roguelite gameplay will be rewarded in fast scaling up your hero but 
defeat will reset your inventory with a little progress forward

Level-Creator  
Choose your land, set your creatures, decorate & get profit for kills.
Passive income can be tempting but watch out, 
your creatures have a small chance upon dieing to get burned and 
turned into DNA for breeding collected by your foe.
